notes.title: Playtest Update (RUS TEXT ONLY)
notes.content:
Implemented control from the gamepad,
Improved boat handling,
Written and added music for several zones and for the battle,
Adjusted the sight, now it is a little friendlier,
Basic cloud movement done,

Made changes to the level design for the convenience of platforming,
The rise to the skyscraper is set up,
Diversified platforming in one place for testing,
Several obstructing objects have been moved.

Added a new dialogue system,
Reworked the text of the dialogs (they are now only in English),
Air restriction in the blower is disabled,
Corrected the collision check for the box,
Added effects of receiving damage "in clouds" like in comics,
Added sounds for inflatable,
Updated sound for coins,

Introductory video was made in the form of 2D animation with music and sounds,

The level has been cleared of some obsolete objects,

Work continued on new modular buildings,
The reworking of ship models continued,
A model of a wall lamp has been made.
Made decals for in-game tips.
The transfer of GDD to Nowshen has been continued for the convenience of further processing,
The basic lore is formalized,
Work continued on the plot foundations for Act 2.

notes.title: Major Gameplay Patch - 9 May 2021
notes.content:
[b]Improved [/b]the visualization of Box physics management. Now you can see through the box while holding it.

Enemies and objects now are sucked in the Hurricane with [b]better animation look.[/b]

[b]ALSO [/b]- I've added the death animation vignette and removed the song when you die. Hated it!
